## Bug

On Windows, every code path that opens the SQLite database fails with:

```
SQL logic error: invalid uri authority: C: (1)
```

`internal/store/store.go` `dsn()` builds the URI as `url.URL{Scheme: "file", Path: filepath.ToSlash(abs)}`. On Windows `filepath.ToSlash` yields `C:/Users/...`, and
title: Windows: SQLite DSN `file://C:/...` breaks all database access ("invalid uri authority: C:")
